gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-petrona: Cherry Swash, commanding, keeps a horseshoe-wide c and matching diagonals. Petrona, with shallow terminal curls and a tempered step from heavy to light, keeps a column of copy from jolting.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-radley: Radley, authoritative, lets the eye slip in and out of its counters. Cherry Swash shouts with a horseshoe c, while Radley keeps a column of copy moving with a light touch of modulation.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-roboto-serif: Mild thick and thin variation and big open eyes mark Roboto Serif, classic. And Cherry Swash shouts with a horseshoe c, while Roboto Serif holds the dignified running text.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-sahitya: A horseshoe-wide c, with diagonals matching the verticals, marks Cherry Swash. And Cherry Swash wants a few large words, while Sahitya, with uncrowded mouths on the s, holds the rest.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-sawarabi-mincho: A horseshoe c and matching diagonals: that is Cherry Swash, commanding, with no thick-and-thin drag on the eye. Sawarabi Mincho holds the ground with terminals cut short of the bowl.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-uchen: Horseshoe c, matching diagonals: that is Cherry Swash, distinctive. Uchen, with welcoming lowercase curves and a midpoint between flat and dramatic strokes, holds the ground under that heading.
gen-gf-chilanka-fs-bespoke-serif: Chilanka, graceful, keeps apertures open and a hand-drawn line of one weight. Bespoke Serif, with thin strokes about half the thick ones, holds the column while that handwriting prefers a compact burst.
gen-gf-chilanka-manrope: Chilanka, relaxed, keeps open apertures, a hand-drawn feel, and stroke thickness that never varies. If Chilanka shrinks, that handwriting fades; Manrope still holds when grown large.
gen-gf-chilanka-switzer: Open apertures, one unvarying stroke: that is Chilanka, graceful and hand-drawn. And Switzer, with tubular letters and c tips that never touch, holds the Swiss ground below.
gen-gf-chivo-mono-gf-lexend-mega: Typewriter-like even-width letters, set with generous gaps: that is Chivo Mono. What lasts is Lexend Mega's one-nib line, near-cap lowercase, and a visible gap on every c.
gen-gf-comic-neue-fs-erode: Open c forms that never read as closed rings mark Comic Neue at once. Erode still holds if grown large, while that rope-thin handwriting fades when the heading shrinks.
gen-gf-comic-neue-gf-syncopate: Technical-pen steadiness and rope-ladder spacing mark Syncopate, with c, e, and s left open. What lasts is Comic Neue's friendly handwriting against that measured sans-serif ground.
gen-gf-comic-neue-switzer: Switzer, Swiss and approachable, keeps tubular letters and c tips that never creep toward touching. What lasts is Comic Neue's rope-thin handwriting against that wire-like ground.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-alike-angular: Alike Angular, traditional, keeps letters held open with a subtle thick and thin cadence. Alike Angular keeps a column of copy moving, while Comic Relief, unfinished bowls and all, shouts above.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-alyamama: Bold, Comic Relief leaves bowls unfinished on one side, with no difference between up and side strokes. Alyamama, with curve endings kept well apart, holds the refined ground under that heading.
